verdict.rationale: Calendly's own Workflows feature automates pre- and post-meeting emails and texts. Routing also automatically matches leads to account owners, and the Callie assistant (beta) coordinates scheduling over email on the user's behalf. These are product-native automations that run without manual action, but they are narrow in scope and only described on marketing pages. Webhooks and the API are developer building blocks and are not credited. Missing for 10: general-purpose user-configurable background automations beyond communications/routing, detailed documentation of Workflows triggers and conditions, Callie maturity beyond beta, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Use Workflows to automate pre- and post-meeting emails and texts to invitees, hosts, and teammates.
Automatically look up and match known leads to assigned account owners from Salesforce and HubSpot.
Add Callie to any email thread to coordinate scheduling on your behalf without switching tools or sacrificing control.
